human_north_star.summary: Prometeo should increasingly replace the human as coordinator, strategist, memory and next-step planner while many disposable /wc chats produce progressively more useful durable work across all projects.
desired_end_state: The human can open identical workers without assigning projects/jobs and later open /g without recap.
Workers do more useful work per chat over time because protocol improvements propagate from evidence.
Useful parallelism can increase without collisions, filler or control-plane overhead rising faster than product output.
Workers and Guides replenish grounded successor work so useful frontier does not starve.
Visible product/project output grows across the portfolio, not only Prometeo infrastructure.
The Guide detects drift, explains trajectory, chooses the next experiment and writes the plan durably before the human has to complain.
Eventually a proven launcher/wake mechanism removes the remaining need for the human to open chats, if the product/runtime actually supports it.
human_should_not_have_to_do: notice and report obvious strategic drift
interpret raw telemetry to know whether the system is improving
human_north_star.privacy_rule: Persist the project intent and operational lessons, not private literal user messages, unless the human explicitly authorizes publication of specific text.

empirical_growth_model.reasoning_model: useful_output_rate ≈ useful_parallelism × useful_yield_per_chat × claim_success × successor_reproduction × visible_value_ratio ÷ human_coordination_cost
empirical_growth_model.proof_law: Cumulative counts alone never prove geometric/exponential growth. Require comparable rolling windows where per-chat useful yield and useful parallelism improve or remain strong while reproduction, visible value and coordination overhead stay within gates.
empirical_growth_model.comparable_window: 10 newly closed evidence-backed worker exam cards when available; otherwise mark comparison INCOMPARABLE rather than substitute cumulative totals.

require: YIELD_PER_CHAT improves in at least 2 consecutive transitions or remains above reproduced high-yield target
REPRODUCTION ratio >=1.0 in each compared window and target >=1.2 for steady compounding
VISIBLE_VALUE does not decline across all compared windows
CONTROL_PLANE_SHARE <=0.15 absent a documented critical rescue

trajectory_checkpoints.label: Yield recovery observed
trajectory_checkpoints.interpretation: Large durable recovery versus the low-yield snapshot, but cumulative totals are not a comparable exponential-growth window and the 10/10 pattern is not independently reproduced.

trajectory_checkpoints.label: Guide takeover quality verified
trajectory_checkpoints.interpretation: Guide continuity progressed from memory recovery to verified read→act→writeback→orient behavior.

trajectory_checkpoints.label: Normal /g self-corrected allocator without special canary

observation.material_action: stale-time José recovery G2 suppressed by fixed-generation policy

trajectory_checkpoints.interpretation: The ordinary /g bootstrap inherited strategy and performed a second distinct systemic correction without transcript recap.

trajectory_checkpoints.label: Empirical trajectory and anti-drift became durable
trajectory_checkpoints.interpretation: The human no longer has to manually remind /g of the long-term growth thesis or detect obvious strategic drift; the Guide now receives a dated empirical North Star and deterministic action branches.

trajectory_checkpoints.label: Universal high-yield pattern falsified by independent tagged sample
trajectory_checkpoints.interpretation: YIELD-10X-V1 failed as a universal post-ownership reproduction pattern. The sample still shows reusable successor/breadth signals, so the route moves to narrower job-class strategy experiments rather than passive continuation.

trajectory_checkpoints.label: Fresh-launch replay regression isolated; v3.30 anti-replay gate bound
trajectory_checkpoints.interpretation: A new human launch reused historical worker completion without a fresh beacon. The system now treats fresh identity as a pre-allocation invariant and requires three post-fix v3.30 launches before broad scaling resumes.

trajectory_checkpoints.label: Fresh launch envelope moved into the human prompt
trajectory_checkpoints.interpretation: The anti-replay rule no longer depends on the model opening /wc before consulting historical context. The canonical human message itself declares a new worker, requires a fresh beacon first, forbids historical substitution and preserves resident work depth.

trajectory_checkpoints.label: v3.30 fresh-launch smoke passed; broad rolling scale restored
trajectory_checkpoints.interpretation: The replay incident is no longer a scale blocker. The next move is a 17-launch measured jump, not another tiny integrity experiment.

trajectory_checkpoints.label: Broad scale split from platform completion; worker graduation becomes blocking gate
trajectory_checkpoints.interpretation: Do not use more workers to hide orchestration weakness. First prove deep single-worker product completion and automatic reallocation; then scale the graduated mechanism.

roadmap.objective: A fresh Guide recovers strategy, acts materially, writes back and orients the human without recap.
exit_evidence: normal /g material action + exact response persistence

roadmap.objective: Turn one 10/10 worker result into a reproducible protocol pattern.
roadmap.pass: At least 3 independent workers with pattern_id=YIELD-10X-V1 score >=8/10.
roadmap.on_pass: Promote pattern laws, ratchet them, then start S2 using the new champion as control.
roadmap.on_fail: Use tagged exam causes to revise/reject pattern; do not copy worker identity.
roadmap.result: 0/20 tagged workers scored >=8; max tagged score 5.

roadmap.objective: Increase useful units/chat by reducing archaeology after ownership.
roadmap.pass: Equal-or-higher useful yield with fewer broad context reads; exact-source capsule never widens authority.

roadmap.objective: Discover whether mutation, verification, integration and Guide work need different post-ownership strategies.
roadmap.activation_gate: Enough tagged v3.27+ exams exist to compare patterns without tiny-sample noise.
roadmap.activation_evidence: Enough v3.27 tagged exams now exist, and universal-pattern failure varies across breadth/reproduction/collision dimensions.
roadmap.sample_gate: Both variants in a job class: >=3 independent workers with >=1 experimental slot.
roadmap.truth_boundary: No cross-class universal winner and no causal attribution of preclaim waste to a post-ownership variant.
roadmap.assignment_truth_boundary: Fresh scoreboard counts may be read only after ownership; derived launch rows never alter causal A/B counts.

roadmap.objective: Stop generic workers from wasting capacity on browser/touch/host/physical jobs and increase the fraction of frontier that is actually executable.
roadmap.activation_gate: SATISFIED: capability-bound/browser/public-origin failures are material and capability ratchets EFF043/EFF044/EFF050/EFF054 are already active.
roadmap.output: Keep specialized capability work visible, filter definitively incompatible generic runtimes before authority, and preserve unknown≠absent.

roadmap.objective: Ensure worker scaling converts into visible project/product progress rather than primarily control-plane work.
roadmap.pass: Across comparable launch windows, product-value conversion rises while optional CONTROL_OVERHEAD stays <=0.15 outside critical rescue and SYSTEM_MULTIPLIER work remains separately measured.

roadmap.objective: Remove the human's remaining need to open worker chats.
roadmap.activation_gate: A real supported launcher/runtime exists and can be verified end-to-end.
roadmap.anti_fake: Never claim background/self-wake from chat text alone.

roadmap.objective: Useful output, successor generation and visible product progress scale faster than coordination overhead across comparable windows.
roadmap.pass: Acceleration gate holds across >=3 comparable windows and no active product project is starved.

action_tree.when: a fresh v3.29 PROD-01 launch window exists
do: read scoreboard.measurement_coverage + growth_health before recommending more capacity
treat every durable beacon as a launch observation even if the worker missed its explicit exam
never use a derived launch row as strategy causal evidence
compare authority rate, productive units/launch and product/system/control conversion against the prior comparable window

action_tree.when: terminal classification is materially below the 0.95 target
do: repair the bounded measurement/terminal path once
do not compensate by opening a larger blind wave
preserve explicit exams as preferred but keep derived launch observability

action_tree.when: EXP-STRATEGY-AB is active and a job class is imbalanced
do: use fresh post-ownership assignment_hint to fill the uniquely underrepresented variant
use beacon hash only for ties/stale/unavailable scoreboard
do not ask the human to route class or variant
do not promote from aggregate/global score

action_tree.when: strategy_experiment_health marks a job class READY_FOR_GUIDE_COMPARISON
do: compare post-ownership metrics only within that job class
inspect exact receipts behind both variants
treat preclaim waste as confounder diagnostics
promote, revise or reject only a class-specific law
prefer already-grounded compatible PRODUCT_VALUE work over optional extra control-plane work
preserve SYSTEM_MULTIPLIER work when it removes a measured multiplicative bottleneck
never create visible filler to satisfy a ratio

action_tree.when: claimable frontier is capability-bound for the current runtime
do: keep S4 capability specialization active in parallel
filter definitively absent capabilities before authority
preserve specialized jobs for capable runtimes and unknown capability as unknown

action_tree.when: a worker stops with one concrete non-duplicate unfinished residual
do: emit at most one successor relay with predecessor evidence and bounded context capsule
do not emit a relay when no concrete residual exists
measure successor rate separately from prose or planning volume

action_tree.when: three comparable windows show higher useful output/launch and product conversion without rising coordination overhead
do: mark S7 compounding evidence candidate
inspect exact window receipts before any exponential-growth claim
keep wake automation separate until an actual supported launcher is proven

action_tree.when: Guide needs the human to recap, route, merge, or choose worker variants
do: raise HUMAN_COORDINATION_REGRESSION
repair continuity/control contract before asking for manual busywork

drift_alarms.trigger: 2 comparable windows with zero visible product changes while noncritical infra/control work continues
infra productive-unit share >0.15 for 2 comparable windows without critical rescue
Guide/worker asks human to perform routing, recap, merging or next-step design already derivable from durable state
median productive slots or exam score drops materially across 2 comparable windows
successor/frontier reproduction ratio <1.0 across a comparable window while useful demand remains
large share of claimable frontier repeatedly cannot be executed by launched worker capability profile
decision-critical runtime/scoreboard is materially older than frontier/current mission
3 Guide cycles make only local fixes without advancing the active roadmap stage or visible product value

mandatory_questions: What changed on the empirical trajectory since the last comparable checkpoint?
Which growth axis is currently the tightest multiplicative bottleneck?
Are we advancing the roadmap stage or only fixing local symptoms?
Did visible product value improve, or only Prometeo control-plane quality?
Is any drift alarm firing before the human notices it?
What branch of the action tree is now true?
What can be executed this turn before asking the human for anything?
guide_cycle_contract.checkpoint_append_rule: Append a trajectory checkpoint only for materially new empirical evidence, a roadmap-stage transition, a verified major regression/correction, or a change in human coordination cost. Do not append timestamp-only noise.
guide_cycle_contract.response_requirement: Every bare /g should summarize trajectory direction and active roadmap stage in plain language, then leave the human with the stable Trajectory link in the utility footer.
guide_cycle_contract.writeback_requirement: If trajectory evidence or roadmap stage changed, update this file before persisting the exact final Guide response.

current_state.strongest_evidence: v3.30 fixed fresh identity and current workers can accumulate useful work, but the 17-chat run exposed that anonymous scale still mixes incompatible demand, missing launches, transport/runtime boundaries and shallow exits.
current_state.weakest_evidence: We have not yet proven the core product claim: one generic worker can reliably finish a substantial page end-to-end and then autonomously reallocate to another project.
current_state.next_decisive_evidence: Implement immutable launch packets/atomic slots, then obtain 3/3 CAT-LAB-V1 primary completions plus 3/3 cross-project reallocations with no human routing.

pre_v329_measured_baseline.truth_boundary: This is a retrospectively measured pre-v3.29 baseline from durable evidence, not evidence that v3.29 improved anything.

prepared_context_strategy.principle: Prepared canonical text is a force multiplier. Give each successor a small, dense, evidence-linked brain instead of making it reconstruct strategy from raw chat archaeology.
prepared_context_strategy.optimization_goal: Increase thinking time spent on causal decisions and useful mutations; decrease repeated reconstruction, stale-history reading and human explanation.
prepared_context_strategy.anti_bloat: Prepared context must stay canonical, compact and evidence-linked. Do not solve continuity by endlessly accumulating prose.

human_feedback_lessons.lesson: Recovery is insufficient: a Guide must materially act and write back before replying when safe.
human_feedback_lessons.durable_response: Current Mission writeback + normal /g execution contract.

human_feedback_lessons.lesson: Minimum execution is insufficient: after acting, Guide must explain trajectory, alternatives, power multipliers and prepared next experiments.
A useful Guide response must leave operational handles at the end: stable links, relevant pages, exact /wc prompt, explicit human action and next Guide cycle.
human_feedback_lessons.durable_response: GDB001 Guide Brief + utility footer + EFF040.

human_feedback_lessons.lesson: The human should not have to notice strategic drift. Growth needs a dated empirical plan, proof criteria, roadmap, anti-drift alarms and deterministic action branches.

More workers is not the objective. The objective is compounding useful output: more useful parallelism and more useful work/chat while reproduction and visible product value rise and human coordination falls.
human_feedback_lessons.durable_response: Empirical growth model and comparable-window acceleration gate.

prompt_conventions.law: Chat title hints are optional UX only. They never affect worker identity, pool identity, routing, authority or evidence.

latest_material_transition.reason: The 17-chat run showed that raw launch count is no longer the highest-leverage variable. Capability-compatible slot assignment and deep end-to-end worker completion must be proven before the next large cohort.
